highlights.title: Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
highlights.summary: Google is bringing Personal Intelligence to Gemini AI in your car. With this update, Gemini in Android Auto and cars with Google built-in can tap into your information across Google apps, including Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, YouTube, and Search.
body: Gemini AI can now draw from Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, and other apps while you drive.

As an example, Google says you can ask Gemini about your flight status if you’re driving to the airport. The AI assistant can pull your flight details from a confirmation message in Gmail and then use that information to look up the status. You can also ask Gemini to “take me to my doctor’s appointment” instead of pulling up directions manually, or ask it to “find the car wash from the photo I took last week and navigate there.”

Google brought its Gemini assistant to Android Auto last year before rolling it out to cars with Google built-in in April. Several carmakers—including Ford, GM, Honda, Nissan, Volvo, and Polestar—have shipped newer cars with Google built-in, which adds support for native Android apps.

body: Javonte Green scored 19 points after not playing in the first half and Cade Cunningham finished with 22 points and eight assists, helping the Pistons to victory as the NBA season tipped off in style on Tuesday.

Paul George scored 38 points, the most by a Celtic in his debut. The nine-time All-Star, in his 17th season, showed he's still got it in his first game with Boston since it acquired him from Philadelphia in exchange for 2024 NBA Finals MVP Jaylen Brown.
Jayson Tatum, a six-time All-Star, was off his game, missing 17 of 23 shots and had 13 points and 11 assists.
His lack of hustle on defense allowed Green to take his time for a fifth 3-pointer that gave the Pistons a 13-point lead with 3:33 left.

highlights.title: Forget ‘Carrie,’ Mike Flanagan’s Best Netflix Miniseries Is a Masterpiece From Start to Finish
highlights.summary: Long before he was at the helm of the Prime Video adaptation of Stephen King's Carrie, Mike Flanagan made waves for himself with his trilogy of Netflix TV miniseries. His ability to helm works that combine horror and genuine human exploration.
body: Before that, however, one Flanagan project stuck with fans and viewers in ways a showrunner can only ever dream of. In a change of pace, this project stepped back from house-haunting and moved on to something bigger: faith. When faith is involved, the structure of the story changes.

Midnight Mass seems, on the surface, like a show about vampires. And while it is, the heart of it is something much more human than that. Allegorical for emotions like grief and loss, Midnight Mass pushes viewers to understand their own issues. It keeps the monsters out of sight for as long as possible, and once they are visible it's difficult to ever imagine having not seen them for what they are in the first place — much like in real life.

Set in Crockett Island, a tiny fishing community that has long since fallen into disrepair, the show follows Riley Flynn (Zach Gilford) as he moves back to the island after being released from prison. Things have changed for the worse since he was there last, and it doesn't seem like the community has much time left due to its dwindling population and fishing prospects.

highlights.title: YouTube might be testing hiding the dislike button
highlights.summary: YouTube appears to be testing hiding the dislike button on videos, as reported by 9to5Google. At least two users on X have recently shared screenshots of the dislike button now being placed in the three-dots submenu, and a user on Reddit also shared an image of the dislike button being absent for…
body: Some users have reported that their YouTube dislike button has been moved to the three-dots menu.

Right now, for me, the dislike button sits right next to the like button under a video. Moving it to a submenu would make it considerably more of an effort to access, meaning that fewer people would likely use it.
It’s unclear how widely this apparent test may be rolled out, and Google didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment.

YouTube has shown a willingness to make changes to the dislike button. In 2021, it hid the public dislike count on videos to help “protect creators from harassment,” though creators can still see dislike counts. Earlier this year, YouTube removed the dislike button from YouTube Shorts, suggesting instead that users take advantage of options in the three-dots menu.

highlights.title: Hat-trick hero Foden shines as Man City thrash AEK Athens
highlights.summary: Phil Foden bagged a hat-trick as dominant Manchester City cruised to a 5-1 win over AEK Athens to claim their second Champions League victory of the campaign.
body: Foden had waited 10 months for a goal before four arrived in back-to-back outings, adding to his strike against Ipswich at the weekend with three tidy finishes, the first two from Rico Lewis assists.

Man City had far too much quality for their Greek visitors despite leaving Erling Haaland in the stands, with Enzo Maresca allowing 17-year-old Floyd Samba to deputise in his place. Maresca proved his point in doing so: City have many other means of scoring beyond Haaland.
Elliot Anderson was also on target in a dominant first half that included 10 efforts on Alberto Brignoli's goal, with Allan striking the crossbar and Rayan Cherki going close.
This was Man City’s 10th win in 12 matches in all competitions this season (L2) – of sides in Europe’s big-five leagues, only Barcelona have won more (11).

highlights.title: Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web
highlights.summary: Meta says it paused a Muse feature that lets you share conversations with the AI assistant after researchers found the URLs publicly available on the web, as reported by Ars Technica.
body: A security firm discovered Muse chats containing a marketing company’s revenue, a workplace’s calendar, a loan application, and more.

“People have the ability to share specific Muse artifacts, which creates a page that can be accessed by those with the link,” Muse spokesperson Tracy Clayton says in an emailed statement to The Verge. “However, we’ve paused this functionality while we review this report and consider changes to how these links can be discovered.”

The feature in question allows you to share your Muse conversation with someone else through a link. But, as pointed out by Claroc, the way Meta designed these links made them easy to find. “Muse builds each share’s web address from the share’s title, a short phrase describing the conversation, then a random ID,” Claroc says. “The hostname usually gave away what a page held before we opened it, and since the link carries that same title and ID, a hostname pulled from DNS rebuilds the link.”

highlights.title: Red Rising Is Officially Returning In 2027
highlights.summary: In the early 2010s, The Hunger Games captivated a generation, and in its wake came another dystopian tale set in the stars. Red Rising, a six-book saga by author Pierce Brown, traded the death-match arena for Mars, where a rigid, color-coded class system dictates daily life on the Red Planet.
body: Fast-forward to 2021, when Jamey Stegmaier of Stonemaier Games created and published a tabletop adaptation of Red Rising, bringing the Mars saga back into the spotlight. The board game was heavily based on the first three books in the series and was praised for its faithfulness to the source material. It allowed players to take command of rival houses and manage their cards to rise through the ranks of the dystopian society. Now, on the horizon for 2027, a digital adaptation of that board game is on the way.

A new digital adaptation of the critically acclaimed Red Rising board game is currently being developed by Canadian studio Emerald City Games. Much like Stegmaier stayed true to the source material when designing his board game, the developers at Emerald City are also making sure that their digital adaptation stays true to the original game.

highlights.title: Supercell completes full acquisition of Metacore
highlights.summary: Supercell has completed its acquisition of Metacore, taking 100% ownership of the Merge Mansion maker. The deal has brought Metacore’s games team into the fold, having "officially started their journey as Supercellians" supported by Supercell peers.
body: Supercell and Metacore originally announced the planned acquisition this May, when Supercell’s intentions to acquire the remainder of the Finnish studio and its flagship game went public. Supercell was already Metacore’s largest shareholder.
Alongside the purchase, Metacore announced it would be cutting up to 160 roles in Finland as part of a restructuring effort.

Months later, Supercell revealed the deal had been signed and that plans for Metacore’s integration were underway. It was expected that the deal would close at the end of September, but it has ultimately taken until today, October 19th, for an official announcement.

"We can finally share that the Supercell acquisition of Metacore and Merge Mansion has been closed. Merge Mansion will transition to be part of Supercell’s game portfolio, and Metacore is now 100% owned by Supercell," Metacore posted on LinkedIn.

highlights.summary: On Tuesday, US District Judge Zachary Bluestone dismissed the lawsuit Ann Altman filed last year alleging that her brother, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, had sexually abused her throughout her childhood.
body: Ann Altman’s lawsuit against her brother was dismissed with prejudice, meaning it can’t be refiled.

When the case was filed last year, a statement shared by Sam Altman, his mother, and his brothers said, “Annie has made deeply hurtful and entirely untrue claims about our family, and especially Sam… All of these claims are utterly untrue. This situation causes immense pain to our entire family.”

Bluestone granted Sam Altman’s motion to dismiss the case with prejudice, meaning it can’t be refiled in that court, while denying Sam’s request for attorney fees and costs. Santos Perez, a lawyer who had represented Ann until withdrawing this month, told The Guardian in a statement that “I am no longer authorized to comment on this case but I continue to believe in Annie.”

highlights.title: French Government Calls Emergency Meetings With Platforms Over Protests
highlights.summary: TikTok and other sites were told to curb protest footage and AI-altered images, while online retailers like Vinted and eBay reportedly signed an agreement stop looted goods from flooding resale sites.
body: TikTok and eBay were among six online platforms summoned by the French government this week, as authorities sought to contain widespread rioting and looting and prevent the resale of stolen goods.

Anne Le Hananff, France’s minister of digital affairs, convened representatives from social media firms on Tuesday for an emergency meeting, after their platforms were blamed for fanning the flames of the worst civil unrest the country has seen in years. The goal of the meeting was to remind platforms that they need to moderate content on their sites, including livestream video, to avoid violent content or anything that could encourage people to break the imposed curfew, according to French TV station BFM.

highlights.summary: England captain Harry Brook admits his side were 'too careful' against Pakistan’s spinners after collapsing to a disappointing 87-run defeat in their ODI tri-series opener.
body: Arafat Minhas starred with bat and ball in Rawalpindi for the hosts, who recovered from 133-5 to post 302-9 from their 50 overs before skittling England for 215 to claim their second win of the tournament.

Pakistan's all-rounder fired 59 off 58 deliveries and was part of a strong lower middle-order fightback, with Hasan Nawaz top-scoring with a 74-ball 79 and Faheem Ashraf adding 39 off 26 deliveries in the closing overs.

Tom Banton and Ben Duckett shifted the momentum in England's favour with a 91-run opening stand, only for Arafat to bamboozle the visitors with a career-best 6-40 and help Pakistan wrap up victory with more than 11 overs to spare.
"We thought they [Pakistan] were slightly under par," Brook said after their defeat. "It got dewy, as we thought it would do and we were pretty happy at halfway.

highlights.title: Cooking Up Magick Book Review
highlights.summary: The first book in a new series called The Dell Chronicles, HL Bernabe’s Cooking Up Magick sets out to be a cozier fantasy version of The Lord of the Rings. And in many ways, it does pull directly from J.R.R. Tolkien’s world.
body: The similarities to The Hobbit and LOTR pretty much end there though, and you don’t get nearly enough detail in the first book to effectively flesh out this alternate version of Middle-earth. What you do get is a lovable main character who is surrounded by an interesting cast of characters. There’s cooking, there’s magic, and there’s even a bit of romantasy thrown in here, but Cooking Up Magick doesn’t serve up enough of any of it to fully bring its story to life.

Cooking Up Magick shines brightest whenever the core characters are interacting with each other. Paisley is a bubbly bright spot among the crew, capable of immense courage and compassion. She has a sort of magnetism that rubs off on her friends and which helps shine a light on each of their individual personalities. Her conversations and moments with her newfound friends (and her Half-Orc love interest) really help to ground the story’s core concept of found family.

highlights.title: Zane Li of Lii Is the Winner of the 2026 CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund
highlights.summary: As this year's CVFF winner, Zane Li will take home a $300,000 cash prize and industry mentorship dedicated to the further growth of his young brand.
body: Tonight at Crane Club, Zane Li, of Lii, was announced as the 2026 winner of the CFDA/ Vogue Fashion Fund. The Chongqing-born, New York-based designer has had quite the year. In April, Li took home the Fashion Trust US Ready-to-Wear Award, and in September, he was declared the winner of the Karl Lagerfeld Prize at the LVMH Prize ceremony in Paris.

At the start of the CVFF finalist process, Li spoke of the financial challenges of running a young brand. “The business side [is the difficult part],” he said. “When you start to consider the income, the revenue, the loss, and the money you spend, suddenly you’re turning your interest into a job. The most rewarding part: You get to control everything. You get to pick your show music, which is my favorite part of doing a show. You get to pick what the color of the carpet is at your show space, and you get to decide what kind of styles you want to sell.”
Li rounds out 2026 with a third cash prize, $300,000 from the CFDA/ Vogue Fashion Fund, and further mentorship from industry experts.

body: Pending the outcome of a dispute in New Zealand, the Chiefs will run on to an NRL field for the first time in two years in a black jersey with a white accented “V” and a chest adorned with gold cultural drawings by PNG artist Tabu, with an alternative version largely swapping the black for white.

The club is yet to designate either as the home design, but has formally adopted black, white and gold as its official colours. The palette echoes the colours in the Papua New Guinea flag of red, black, yellow and white that have traditionally been worn by its national sporting teams.
The Chiefs join Penrith, Wests, the Warriors and 2027 entrants Perth Bears as NRL clubs who regularly wear black.
A legal dispute between New Zealand Rugby and the NRL over the Chiefs trademark centres around the Super Rugby club Waikato Chiefs formed in 1996.

highlights.summary: The KPop Demon Hunters sequel won’t be repeating the mistakes of its predecessor, having secured a guaranteed theatrical release following the first film’s smashing success.
body: The news was casually and somewhat unceremoniously buried in an October 20 report from The Hollywood Reporter, which dove into the events behind the departure of Netflix’s former film chief, Dan Lin.
According to THR, Lin helped secure a theatrical release for KPop Demon Hunters 2, a move that the outlet noted “hasn’t been officially announced.”

News of a sequel — er, more like sequels — was revealed in November 2025 when Variety reported that Netflix and Sony had inked a deal for a second animated film, with a release date planned for 2029. Around that same time, The Wrap revealed what’s next for the KPop Demon Hunters universe, including plans for a live-action movie, a stage play and two sequels to create a film trilogy. A spinoff series and short film were also mentioned, though none of these particular projects have been officially announced by the streamer.

highlights.title: Netflix Chiefs Concede That Slowdown in U.S. Viewing Sparked the Content Leadership Shakeup: ‘We’re Focusing on Execution,’ Ted Sarandos Says
highlights.summary: Netflix co-CEOs Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters nodded to slowdown in U.S. viewing and ad sales that spurred the radical shake-up of the streamer’s content leadership during Tuesday’s conversation with Wall Street analysts after its third-quarter earnings release.
body: Peters emphasized that “the quality, quantity and variety of viewing remains healthy and it drives our business model. And the best evidence that we’ve got that we’re delivering that value is churn. We’ve got healthy retention in every region,” he said. For the quarter ended Sept. 30, the level of churn improved on a global basis and in the U.S.

“The ultimate determinant of are we delivering that value is the reaction to price changes. And those recent price changes that we did, including in the United States, have gone well. We’ve seen results that are consistent with past changes,” Peters said.
Most of the regions outside the U.S. delivered strong viewing and engagement, he added.

“Our local titles from those regions are driving engagement and they’re driving business growth. And you can see how our business model works here. We specifically highlighted India, which had a strong slate with a couple titles really, really performing. And as a result, view hours in Q3 in India grew 24% on an absolute basis,” Peters said. “They were also up on a per-member basis, all of which drives membership.”

highlights.title: Football regulator has ‘absolute power’ to force Manchester City sale if verdict upheld
highlights.summary: IFR chair David Kogan insists regulator has power to act. City have appealed against Premier League’s charges. The Independent Football Regulator (IFR) will have “absolute power” to force Manchester City’s owners to sell if they are ultimately found to have run the club improperly, the watchdog’s…
body: Manchester City have been found guilty of circumventing Premier League rules by an independent commission, which found they set up “sham” commercial arrangements to inflate revenues or reduce costs by over £900m over a nine-season period.

They were also found to have made “concerted efforts” to “stop and frustrate” the Premier League’s investigation into those arrangements. City have lodged an appeal, claiming the verdict “contains clear material errors, of law, principle and fact, and is unsafe”.

David Kogan, the chair of the IFR, told podcast The Rest Is Football it was premature to talk about any action his organisation might take while the appeal was ongoing. Kogan did confirm, though, that the IFR had “absolute power” to force a sale by the club’s ownership, if that was felt to be appropriate.

“We have the power to ask an owner to step away from a club if we believe that they run a club in a way that is neither fit, fair or done with propriety,” Kogan said. Asked if an owner could refuse to divest, Kogan replied: “No, no, no. We’ve got absolute power to do so.”

body: That's apparently the thinking behind the official reveal of Shrek 2 Remastered, which has officially been announced with a trailer that channels nothing less than the cinematic style of Rockstar's GTA 6 marketing.

Developed by Aspyr, Shrek 2 Remastered will launch on Nov. 10 for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Windows PC, and Xbox Series X. The game first surfaced last month through an achievement leak, followed by an early Xbox Store listing that revealed details about its upgrades.

Originally developed by Luxoflux and published by Activision, Shrek 2 is an action-adventure platformer based on DreamWorks Animation's hit 2004 film. Players travel through locations including Shrek's swamp, Fiona's castle and the kingdom of Far Far Away, revisiting scenes from the movie alongside additional sequences created for the game.

Players can control Shrek and other familiar characters, including Fiona and Donkey, as they fight enemies and tackle platforming challenges. The original game also supported cooperative play, letting up to four players join in locally.

highlights.title: Trump is giving Nick Shirley $10,000 and launching a $25 million fraud bounty program
highlights.summary: Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance said on Tuesday that the Trump administration was giving right-wing YouTuber Nick Shirley $10,000 and launching a $25 million bounty program for members of the public to report fraud.
body: The administration told Fox News that it was also launching the Fraud Whistleblower Incentive Program (WHIP), a pool of $25 million open to anyone who believes they’ve witnessed fraud. A “particular emphasis” is placed on fraud in hospice, home healthcare, daycares, and special services, a government website says. A chatbot collecting responses instructs the reporting party: “Briefly describe what you saw, heard, or read. A few sentences are enough. Include names, dates, amounts, or records if you have them, and how you know. Note any details you’re unsure about.”

According to Fox News and the reporting portal, members of the public who flag fraud are eligible to get up to $30,000 if a tip submitted leads to a conviction or significant federal action. But speaking on Tuesday, Trump contradicted the $30,000 ceiling.

”If you turn somebody in and … you find $1 billion, we are giving a commission to that person of 1 percent,” Trump said today. (One percent of $1 billion would exceed the $30,000 cap.) “And if it’s $10 billion, $200 billion, $400 billion, we’re giving a 1 percent commission to that person,” Trump continued.

highlights.title: Henry Cavill’s Upcoming Sci-Fi Space Opera Series Writer Admits It's Been ‘Brutally Difficult’
highlights.summary: Mike Flanagan has spent years bringing some of horror's most beloved stories to the screen, from Stephen King's Doctor Sleep to Netflix's The Haunting of Hill House. His latest King adaptation, Carrie, has earned rave reviews and is dominating streaming on Prime Video, but the filmmaker's next…
body: Speaking on The Process Unlocked podcast, Flanagan described the Amazon project, which he's developing alongside star and executive producer Henry Cavill, as feeling like he's “climbing my adaptation Everest.”

The challenge, he explained, is figuring out where to begin with a franchise that has accumulated decades of lore, hundreds of novels and thousands of years of fictional history, pointing to the franchise's enormous cast and sprawling timeline.

“These are novel lengths. These are not small. But there are so many characters. It takes place over so many thousands of years. There's so much there,” he said. “The challenge is how do you get in? That's really a brutally difficult adaptation, but it's been so fun for it.”
